confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant and coffee anchors use Numbeo Amman averages seen in search excerpts (crowd-sourced, undated). Hostel anchors use Hostelz averages and listings, some undated. Hotel anchors are low confidence: Skyscanner and Kayak averages, a World Travel Guide price band and from-prices, with unclear tax treatment (plus or minus 15 percent). Beer is a 500 ml equivalent of Numbeo's pint figure, consistent with Expatistan (May 2026); an undated forum post suggests lower prices. Cocktail (about 1.2 times beer) rests on one weak Expatistan point, so it is low confidence. Wine by the glass has no verified price and is set at about 0.9 times beer, so it is low confidence. Sources disagree on how many restaurants serve alcohol; drink anchors assume licensed venues. July 2026 is outside Ramadan. FX is from a search summary of the RBA 4pm figure; the RBA table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy used; anchors are Amman-specific. The Jordanian dinar is pegged to the US dollar at about 0.709 JOD per USD, which keeps USD values stable. Cocktail and wine were set from the local draft-beer relationship because direct per-drink data were thin.
